universal_patterns.pattern: every board[^.]*referred to in this chapter
for the purposes of this chapter\b[^.]*

proposal.rationale: The Article 1B sections (military members/spouses provisions) repeatedly use phrasing like "all boards referred to in this chapter", "The Boards referred to in this chapter", which are title-wide universal signals. I broadened the universal pattern to match "(each|all) boards (or licensing authority) referred to in this chapter" plus a general "the boards referred to in this chapter" variant, which covers §30-1B-2 through §30-1B-7 and §30-1-23. §30-1B-8 is an exclusion carve-out and will correctly remain undetermined (it doesn't match universal patterns and shouldn't). §30-1B-1 (legislative findings) and §30-1B-9 (liberality of construction) are boilerplate and may stay undetermined — they don't articulate scope themselves. §30-1D-1 enumerates specific practice-act sections via "boards governing licensing under the following sections: Section ten, article three of this chapter; section four, article three-e..." — added a trigger pattern to capture this enumeration. Chapter/section cite patterns unchanged. slug_prefix remains "article" since Chapter 30 articles are the practice-act units.
